subject: new segmentation function in methylKit methSeg()

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: new segmentation function in methylKit methSeg()
parts:
We implemented a new function in methylKit methSeg() it can segment methylation profiles to high/low methylation regions or any other data-driven classification. It can also work on differential methylation profiles to group differentially methylated regions. details are here
http://zvfak.blogspot.de/2015/06/segmentation-of-methylation-profiles.html

messages.subject: Re: new segmentation function in methylKit methSeg()

Hi Altuna,

I get an error which I think is related to not having DMR data mainly when working with small scaffolds. When running with bigger scaffolds which I know have DMRs there is no problem.
The message error is the following

Error in if (all(segMedianT == 0)) { : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
Calls: methSeg -> do.call -> fastseg -> segmentGeneral
Execution halted

Is there a possibility to catch this error??

Thanks!
Cristian

This is a very old topic, but I encountered the same problem. The solution is to make sure that an input GRanges for the methSeg function in methylkit has more than 2 ranges in each chromosome :)
cheers,
